questions.question: You are auditing an AI-native recommendation API that currently relies only on static unit tests and offline Precision@K metrics. Your gap analysis reveals that the system frequently fails when real users request rare categories. Which improvement best addresses this evaluation gap?
options: Increase code coverage of the API route handlers to 100%.
Integrate behavioral test suites using edge-case inputs alongside online slice-based evaluation metrics.
Measure latency using load testing tools without changing model evaluation metrics.
Switch the recommendation algorithm database from PostgreSQL to Redis.
questions.explanation: Addressing coverage gaps in AI services requires behavioral testing targeted at edge cases and slice-based metrics to evaluate sub-population performance beyond aggregate precision.

questions.question: An engineering team is selecting an automated testing mechanism for a real-time recommendation system. They need to evaluate output quality under live data distribution shifts without disrupting user experience. Which framework setup is most appropriate?
options: Stress testing the database under peak load.
Manual code reviews of the model prompt and architecture.
Shadow deployment combined with automated divergence and drift metrics.
Offline unit testing using static mock inputs.
questions.explanation: Shadow deployment allows real-time evaluation against live production traffic using drift/divergence metrics without impacting actual end users.

questions.question: A evaluation framework for a recommendation API measures accuracy (Recall@K) and API latency. However, users complain that the recommendations feel repetitive and predictable. Which metric should be added to the comparative evaluation framework to fix this assessment gap?
options: Cyclomatic Complexity of the API pipeline
questions.explanation: Intra-List Diversity directly measures the variety of recommended items within a list, resolving the gap where accuracy metrics favor repeated popular items.

questions.question: You are reviewing an AI-native recommendation API's evaluation pipeline that lacks robust failure mode detection. Propose one automated testing mechanism and one metric to evaluate how gracefully the system handles out-of-domain inputs.
questions.answer: Implement adversarial perturbational testing (or behavioral testing) with synthetic out-of-domain inputs, and measure Fallback/Refusal Rate or Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detection Accuracy.
questions.explanation: Adversarial or behavioral testing generates non-standard inputs to test resilience, while Fallback or OOD detection metrics measure whether the system safely defaults to non-hallucinated responses.
